mutant.original: `representation id "${r.id}" has characters not allowed in a template`
mutant.lineText: if (!/^[^\s"<>&]+$/.test(r.id)) p.push(`representation id "${r.id}" has characters not allowed in a template`);
mutant.nextText: if (!(r.bandwidth > 0)) p.push(`representation ${r.id}: bandwidth must be above zero`);
